_about: Public-domain Hugh of Saint Victor (about 1096-1141, canon regular of Paris) in English for the Word Hoard: the Explanation of the Rule of St Augustine, tr. Aloysius Smith (London: Sands, 1911), from an Internet Archive scan. Richard of Saint Victor has no pre-1930 English beyond the anonymous Middle English Benjamin in Gardner's anthology, so he has no shelf. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 26 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Translators recorded per item where the title page names one; every printing dated or catalogued before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
